title: OP-18 store event: Bandai's 4th Anniversary event runs 20 Nov – 17 Dec
detail: Official page lists the OP-18 Release Event (store tournaments tied to the 4th anniversary). It is the English-language page, so French shops may run it differently. OP-18 itself is expected 20 Nov (EN) and 21 Nov (JP) per retailer calendars; French date still unconfirmed. A tournament-legality note (OP-18 playable about a week after release) comes from a secondary source, unconfirmed.

title: Tomorrow: Pokémon Special Event Buenos Aires and four One Piece regionals; Porto/Sydney results still missing
detail: Limitless's One Piece list still ends 26 Jul, so winners of the 7 Nov Porto and Sydney regionals remain unconfirmed.

title: Price check: no 20% moves, Delta Reign shelves are mostly pre-orders
detail: TCGdex Cardmarket 7-day vs 30-day: Mew ex 152 €83.35 vs €88.55 (−6%); Pikachu ex 150 €51.10 vs €53.76 (−5%); Gengar ex 154 €63.63 vs €66.95 (−5%); Jirachi ex €31.48 vs €33.07 (−5%); Morpeko ex 117 €48.68 vs €51.85 (−6%); Mega Darkrai ex 116 €172.61 vs €178.29 (−3%). Miyata Kard Market's Delta Reign page now shows 2 items 'En vente' and 38 'Précommande' (second wave 17 Nov, unconfirmed).
